newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close mostly unchanged.

text.p: Oct 30 - U.S. debt futures closed mostly unchanged, as the market erased nearly all the day's gains on long liquidation. Traders said the market had to digest the increase of 31,000 in Dec bond open interest on Tuesday. Dec could have trouble rising above 114-00; March Euros seen capping gains at 94.50. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
